title: Dell security advisory (AV26-1161)
description: As of November 16, 2026, Dell is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Ansible Storage for PowerFlex
	Prior to 3.2.0

Ansible Storage for PowerStore
	Prior to 3.9.0

Ansible Storage for Unity
	Prior to 1.2.13

Terraform Provider for PowerFlex
	Prior to 1.9.0

Terraform Provider for PowerStore
	Prior to 1.3.1
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
